Watch the full film on the channel.

On this channel, you will find animated stories from the world of Westeros presented through cinematic storytelling.

Some scenes, dialogues, and events have been expanded or slightly altered to create a more complete and immersive narrative experience. These additions are based on the logic of the world, established lore, and the personalities of the characters.

Arthur Dayne, the legendary Sword of the Morning, was considered the greatest knight of his age and wielded the famous blade Dawn. His unmatched skill and unwavering honor made him one of the most iconic warriors in Westerosi history.

Watch the full animated film on my channel. ⚔️


#ArthurDayne #SwordOfTheMorning #GameOfThrones #HouseOfTheDragon #ASOIAF #A SongOfIceAndFire #Westeros #Targaryen #Kingsguard #Dawn #Fantasy #Medieval #Epic #Animation #AnimatedFilm #FanFilm #GeorgeRRMartin #Shorts #YouTubeShorts #GoT
